sentence: Investment efficiency responds most where knowledge intensity, R&D spending and internal controls are strong
passage: [Lin, Li et al. (2026), p. 1] "This effect is more pronounced in high knowledge-intensity firms, high R&D-intensity firms, and firms with sound internal controls."

gemini.note: The passage states the effect is comparatively 'more pronounced', which does not fully support the superlative claim that it responds 'most'.
